text: A total of 82 percent of eligible final year students were placed during the 2024-25 placement season. The highest package offered was 18 LPA and the average package was 6.2 LPA.
Companies that recruited from the campus in 2024-25 included Northwind Systems, Bluepeak Software, Orbit Analytics and Kestrel Technologies.
Students must have no active backlogs and a minimum CGPA of 6.0 to participate in campus placements.
